{{recipe}}

'''''Pasta alla gricia''''' is an Italian pasta dish, typical of Rome. The preparation is very simple and quick. There are several versions of the recipe but they are all very similar.

==Ingredients==
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] (rigatoni or spaghetti)
* 200–300 g [[Cookbook:Guanciale|guanciale]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Pecorino Romano Cheese|Pecorino romano]], [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]]

== Procedure ==
# Heat water and salt in a pot until it starts [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]].
# Add the pasta, and cook until [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]].
# Cook the guanciale in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] until fat melts almost completely.
# Add the cooked pasta to the guanciale pan, and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] for 2 minutes.
# Add grated pecorino romano and black pepper to the frying pan, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to blend the ingredients.
